## Purpose

Table Step 2B records the completed human review of the exact suppressed products created by Step 2A. It creates one approval receipt and makes no changes to the reviewed tables.

::: {.callout-warning collapse="false"}
Approval is not publication. All products remain in private staging until Table Step 3 deliberately promotes the approved package.
:::

## Before you start

For the selected year and month, confirm that you have reviewed:

- the Step 1 QA summary;
- the Step 2A suppression summary and every private worklist row;
- all primary and complementary suppression decisions;
- every sheet in the proposed publication workbook;
- all seven public-safe DTA/CSV pairs;
- all generated Markdown tables and YTD labels; and
- the package metadata, catalogue, readme and public manifest.

Generated outputs must never be corrected manually. If anything is wrong, correct the source or code and rerun the relevant earlier step.

## Run Step 2B

1. In Stata, open **User > BNR > Produce tables > Step 2B: Approve reviewed tables**.
2. Enter the year and month of the reviewed Step 2A package.
3. Enter your full name.
4. Choose your authorised role:
   - BNR Lead
   - BNR Analyst
   - BNR Developer
5. Select each of the five confirmations only after completing that check.
6. When all boxes are selected, the **Approve** button becomes available.
7. Select **Approve**.
8. Confirm that the operational summary says `COMPLETED - APPROVED, NOT PUBLISHED`.

## Five approval confirmations

The approver confirms that:

1. the intended dataset release and reporting period were used;
2. results and permanent YTD presentation are plausible and correct;
3. every suppression flag and disclosure-control decision was reviewed;
4. the publication workbook and all public-ready products were inspected; and
5. the complete package is ready for publication.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Command-line use

The same five checks are compulsory when the DO file is run directly:

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/tables/bnr_step2b_cvd_tables_approve.do" ///
    2024 1 "Full name" "BNR Analyst" ///
    release results disclosure workbook ready
```

The DO file stops if any confirmation word is missing.
:::

## What Step 2B checks

Before writing approval, Step 2B confirms that:

- the Step 2A private review files are present;
- `package.yml` identifies the selected package and coverage period;
- the package status is `public_ready_unapproved`;
- the package has not already been approved;
- `public_manifest.csv` has the required structure and safe relative paths; and
- every required product listed in the manifest exists.

## What Step 2B creates

```text
cvd_tables_YYYY_MM/
└── public_ready/
    └── approval.yml
```

The receipt records the approval status, package and coverage, approver identity and role, approval date and time, all five confirmations, the checked manifest and that publication has not yet occurred.

Step 2B does not alter the public workbook, datasets, Markdown, metadata, manifest or readme.

## Corrections after approval

An existing approval cannot be silently replaced. If a product needs correction:

1. correct the source data or code;
2. rerun Step 2A with explicit replacement;
3. repeat the complete review; and
4. run Step 2B again.

Step 2A replacement removes the earlier approval because it no longer applies to the rebuilt products.

## Next action

Proceed to Table Step 3. It will require `approval.yml`, validate the approved manifest and promote only the approved public-ready products. It will not recalculate tables or make new disclosure decisions.
